identity_cost.detail: A card and a phone number, because a sandbox bills through an Azure subscription. On top of the subscription, creating a sandbox needs a role assignment: 'To manage and create sandboxes, you need the Azure role Container Apps SandboxGroup Data Owner.' Country limit, quoted: 'If your country is not listed, the offer is not available in your region.'
